title: Rav Chiyya bar Amram
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Bekhorot 36b he said: “Three permit the firstborn where there is no expert.” But Hyman says the reading should be “Rabbi Chiyya bar Avin said that Rav Amram said,” as in Yevamot 25b; and so is the reading of Shitah Mekubbetzet.[^1]

notes.text: Bekhorot 36b has Rav Chiyya bar Amram; Yevamot 25b gives Rabbi Chiyya bar Avin reporting Rav Amram. Hyman's statement of what SHOULD READ remains an attributed textual correction, not a new father-son identification. The reported Shitah Mekubbetzet reading was not freshly collated.
